title: Skill Creator Package Manifest
description: Schema for the JSON package manifest produced by the Skill Creator agent. The JSON envelope is a transport container; the actual content (skill_md, references, scripts, assets) is in Markdown/Python format aligned with the agentskills.io specification.

metadata.description: Skill metadata fields for YAML frontmatter

name.description: Skill name in kebab-case, alphanumeric and hyphens only, max 63 characters

description.description: Brief description of the coaching skill and when to use it

skill_md.description: The full Markdown body for SKILL.md. Must contain the complete coaching protocol with SOP steps, knowledge modules, and coaching guidelines. Must include Markdown headings: '## SOP Steps', '### Step N:', '## Key Knowledge Points', and '## Coaching Guidelines'. Must not include '## Assessment Rubric', '## Training Checkpoints', weighted scoring tables, or similar checklist sections.

references.description: Reference documentation files. Keys are filenames (e.g., 'knowledge-base.md'), values are file contents. Must have at least 1 entry.

scripts.description: Executable scripts for validation and enforcement. Keys are filenames (e.g., 'validate_response.py'), values are script contents. Must have at least 1 entry.

assets.description: Templates, coaching aids, and static resources. Keys are filenames, values are file contents.

summary.description: 2-3 sentence overview of the skill's scope, target audience, and key learning outcomes
